title: Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. translated_title: 回复之前先重放：用于统一多模态编码的二次审视提示
translated_abstract: 解决多模态任务需要视觉-语言模型（VLM）对图像和问题文本形成统一的理解。然而，在当前VLM的因果注意力机制下，一个token只能关注它之前的内容。因此，无论哪种模态先出现，它都是在只观察到部分输入的情况下被编码的，无法感知其余的多模态上下文。我们提出了二次审视提示（Second-Look Prompting, SLP），这是一种无需训练的方法，它在输入中重复图像-问题对。在重复的副本中，每个视觉和文本token都可以关注完整的输入，从而产生对该图像-问题对的统一多模态编码。此外，新增的视觉token所带来的贡献超出了重新暴露图像本身：即使在它们的位置放置一张空白图像，也能提升推理能力。在12个基准测试中，SLP提升了所有被评估模型的整体平均得分，涵盖九个开源模型（3B-72B）和三个专有前沿模型，提升幅度…
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的“二次审视提示”（SLP）方法，通过在输入中重复图像-问题对，使每个token都能关注完整输入从而实现统一的多模态编码，并在12个基准测试上提升了所有评估模型的平均得分。
en_tdlr: Second-Look Prompting (SLP) is a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input, allowing every token to attend to the complete input for unified multimodal encoding, and improves the average scores of all evaluated models across 12 benchmarks.
